name: Kameron Battle
strengths: Battle carries with feature-back volume and finishes runs with scoring juice between the tackles and outside.
Battle shows real receiving value out of the backfield — not just a downhill pounder.
Battle wins as a compact, decisive runner who stresses defenses in space once he clears the first level.
weaknesses: Battle still needs SEC mass on a ~5-9 / 180 frame before he can lean on every early-down snap.
comparison: Battle comps to Justice Hill — 5-10 / ~190 mold; compact burst, one-cut decisiveness, and enough receiving juice to stay on the field (size-matched within ~1–2" of Battle's ~5-9 / 180 frame).
projection: Battle projects as a Year 1–2 package / change-of-pace back who develops into the RB rotation, then competes for every-down snaps — ceiling as a compact SEC feature back with third-down value.
schemeFit: Battle fits a zone/gap RB room that wants a compact one-cut runner with pass-game versatility.
insiderNotes: Battle is a compact in-state RB with feature-back production and receiving juice. Florida has ramped communication nonstop and already locked a game-day visit while sitting atop his On3 RPM board.
